q: What do we know about the Antichrist?
a: We know that he is coming.

q: How will we recognize the Antichrist?
a: The Antichrist will deny the Father and the Son.

q: How are the children of the devil apparent?
a: The children of the devil are apparent because they do not do righteousness and they do not love their brother.

q: What spirit does not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh?
a: The spirit of an antichrist does not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh.

q: What is the victory that has overcome the world?
a: Faith is the victory that has overcome the world.
